full_judgment: Mainur Reza Chowdhury J: This petition for leave to appeal filed by pre-emptor-petitioner is against judgment of the High Court Division in Civil Revision No. 331 of 1986 affirming the judgment and order passed by the learned Subordinate Judge, Rajbari, in Miscellaneous Appeal No. 115 of 1985, setting aside the order No. 61 dated 17-7-1985 passed by munsif (now Assistant Judge) Rajbari in Miscellaneous Case No. 76 of 1985 dismissing the application for pre-emption under section 96 of the East Bengal State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950 filed by pre-emptor respondent.
